title: Denmark's Forest Kindergartens
summary: An SBS Dateline short documentary on Danish forest kindergartens, where children play freely outdoors, climb trees and use knives with little adult intervention.
why: Recommended as a concise look at the culture behind outdoor kindergartens in threads on parenting and education.

quote.text: This is a very concise (11:32) video that goes over some of the culture and thinking around outdoor kindergartens.
